text:
jamal: hey folks — starting Tue as AE. Still missing HubSpot + Gong access. Who do I ping? Also does someone have the latest outbound playbook and the 1-pager deck? Trying to prep for shadow calls.

olivia: welcome jamal! :tada: cc @tyler-salesops for access. Playbook lives in Confluence but i'll drop drive link.

tyler-salesops: hey @jamal — congrats and welcome! can you paste your employee id here? I can triage access. In the meantime, please fill the access request form: https://redwood-internal.example.com/access-requests
Form fields: name, employee_id, tool list (HubSpot, Gong), urgency. ETA 24-48 hrs once submitted.

jamal: id A-3842. Submitted the form now.

access-bot: New ticket created: ACCESS-2024-358 (HubSpot, Gong) assigned to tyler-salesops. Status: Open.

tyler-salesops: got it — I'll push this. HubSpot should be ok by EOD tomorrow, Gong might need SSO mapping (took ~36 hrs last time).

nina: @jamal hi! i'm the SE you'll shadow. here's the quickplay call checklist and a link to the playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/playbooks/redwood-sales-outbound
Quick tips: use 'Discovery-B2B' template in Gong, tag as 'AE-shadow' for recordings, and set Gong coverage to 'Full' for first 3 weeks.

nina: sample HubSpot filter to see top-stage opps:
```
View: Deals > Filter: Stage in ('Proposal','Negotiation') AND Owner = 'jamal'
Columns: Company, ARR, Last Contact
```

maria: welcome! CS note — set onboarding call in calendar with CS within first week. I'll add you to the customer enablement Slack channel. Also grab the one-pager here: https://redwood.example.com/sales-cs/one-pager.pdf

olivia: also FYI — playbook has elevator pitch snippets + objection handling for 'privacy/SLA' and 'cost'. DM me if you want a 30m walk-through tomorrow.

jamal: thanks everyone, appreciate the fast help. If Gong isn't available before shadow calls, can I join as listener via link?

nina: yes — i'll invite you from my session. If recording isn't ready, i'll upload manual recording to shared drive.

tyler-salesops: update: HubSpot access granted (you should get invite). Gong still pending SSO, escalated to security. Ticket ACCESS-2024-358.

jamal: invite arrived, can see contacts. Fingers crossed for Gong :crossed_fingers: 

access-bot: Ticket ACCESS-2024-358 updated: assigned to security-team. ETA 36h.

olivia: welcome aboard again! first week checklist: 1) HubSpot access, 2) Gong access, 3) join AE team standup, 4) shadow 2 calls, 5) 30m with me to review playbook. I'll DM calendar invites.

jamal: perfect — excited. Thanks everyone :rocket:
